args.root_cause: Overworld chunk (1,0) in world/region/r.0.0.mca was corrupt on disk (zlib "incorrect header check" — the chunk's compressed payload was damaged; mca inspect showed 1 of 361 chunks corrupt, saved-timestamp 05:50:30). The server went down at ~07:42:43 and restarted on its own; on startup Paper's RegionFile I/O thread and ChunkLoadTask threw java.util.zip.ZipException loading world chunk (1,0) and logged "chunk data will be lost", meaning the chunk (x 16–31, z 0–15, right beside spawn) would have been regenerated blank. All other overworld region files (r.-1.-1, r.-1.0, r.0.-1) and world/entities/r.0.0.mca were clean. The backup backups/world-2026-10-31/region/r.0.0.mca held an intact copy of chunk (1,0) saved 05:50:04 (~26 s older than the corrupt copy). I could not determine why the server initially went down — the rotated log logs/2026-11-01-1.log.gz is gzipped and unreadable via the log tool.
args.actions: 1) Baseline status/logs: healthy (TPS 20, 2 players). 2) wait 20s — status showed server DOWN. 3) Read latest.log: server had restarted at 07:42:43 and logged ZipException "incorrect header check" for world chunk (1,0), "chunk data will be lost". 4) declare_incident. 5) Scoped: grep logs for all "Failed to load chunk" (only (1,0)); mca inspect world/region/r.0.0.mca (1 corrupt: 1,0); inspect backups/world-2026-10-31/region/r.0.0.mca (0 corrupt, chunk 1,0 ok); inspect r.-1.-1, r.-1.0, r.0.-1 (all 0 corrupt); tried reading rotated .gz log (binary, unreadable); fs_read protected.json (too large, not read). 6) server stop (world saved) — required for copy_chunk. 7) mca copy_chunk chunk (1,0) from backups/world-2026-10-31/region/r.0.0.mca into world/region/r.0.0.mca — succeeded. 8) mca inspect world/region/r.0.0.mca: 400 chunks, 0 corrupt, chunk 1,0 ok (backup timestamp 05:50:04); server start in parallel. 9) Verified: status UP, TPS 20, both players (Steve_Mines, Alex_Builds) reconnected, all 5 plugins enabled; logs grep "Failed to" → none; grep ERROR → only the benign oshi sysctl warning. 10) Inspected world/entities/r.0.0.mca (0 corrupt). 11) Watched ~70 s post-fix; stable throughout. No bans, no file deletions, no config edits.
args.residual_risk: Chunk (1,0) now contains the backup copy saved 05:50:04 — about 26 seconds older than the corrupted on-disk copy (05:50:30), so any block changes in that single chunk during that window are lost; also anything the players did in that chunk between the 07:42:46 auto-restart (when Paper loaded it as a fresh/regenerated chunk) and my 07:43:20 stop was discarded in favor of the real backup data. The underlying cause of the on-disk corruption and of the initial unplanned server shutdown at ~07:42:43 is not identified (rotated log is gzipped and unreadable via the log tool; no disk-pressure or memory signals — disk 5%, heap normal). If the shutdown was a crash or an unclean kill, corruption could recur; recommend reviewing logs/2026-11-01-1.log.gz and any crash-reports, checking the host for disk/IO faults, and keeping the 2026-10-31 backup until a fresh clean backup is taken. The server was briefly down (~15 s) during my stop/copy/start, disconnecting both players; both reconnected.
